'''2011 Bespin Regionals Nick Swedal DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Swedal]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' TTO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
